name: digital product
proposition: products people can use, not decks that photograph well.
symptom: the roadmap is full and nothing useful reaches users. the site or app undoes the strategy. every release needs a new vendor brief.
craft: we design and ship the product: discovery, ux, architecture, build and measurement, with one primary outcome per release.
outcome: a product people can use, a team that understands it, and a paper trail that shows what moved.

name: ai implementation
proposition: ai that users touch every week, inside your controls.
symptom: pilots multiply, production does not. use cases were chosen for demos, not value. nobody owns the path through change control.
craft: we prioritise use cases, prove them fast, then deploy with governance gates built in, inside your pmo and release process.
outcome: ai that users touch every week, with accountability your board can follow.

name: ai governance
proposition: controls your auditors can verify before the models go live.
symptom: pressure to adopt ai without a framework that survives audit. policy is a slide. risk sits in someone's head.
craft: readiness assessments, responsible ai policy, regulatory alignment and board reporting before implementation starts.
outcome: controls your auditors can verify and a path for delivery that does not bypass them.

name: onboard + operate
proposition: capability that stays after we leave.
symptom: the build ends and capability walks out the door. every change means calling the agency back.
craft: training, centres of excellence, product ownership and an operating model designed for the day after we leave.
outcome: your people can run, improve and explain the system without us, unless you choose motion.
